note: Adapted from the species description of Chhotani (1997), originally in English; the alate is recorded as unknown, so that section is not included; the second half of the same scanned page contains the generic characters of Indocapritermes and was not used; synonymy lists, figure numbers and distribution records are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, about twice as long as wide, mandibles strongly asymmetrical, the left mandible strongly twisted at midlength with a broadly rounded apex; total length 6.25–6.60 mm. Worker head capsule subcircular, antennae 14-segmented, total length 4.0–4.6 mm. Alate unknown.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow to deep straw yellow, antennae yellowish brown, left mandible dark greyish brown, right mandible reddish brown, body and legs yellowish white; head and pronotum sparsely setose, body densely setose; total length 6.25–6.60. Head capsule subrectangular, about twice as long as wide (length including mandibles 4.0–4.25, length to mandibular base 2.50–2.75, width 1.32–1.41, ratio of width to length 0.52–0.54); median arm of the Y-shaped suture prominent; sides nearly parallel and straight. Fontanelle minute, situated at about four fifths of the length of the head from its posterior margin. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 about equal to or slightly shorter than segment 3, segment 4 shortest. Labrum subquadrate, asymmetrical, anterior margin slightly incurved and nearly straight, anterolateral projections very minute. Mandibles strongly asymmetrical, slightly longer than half the head length (left 1.45–1.48, right 1.40–1.45, ratio of left mandible length to head length 0.56–0.58); left mandible strongly twisted at midlength, broadly rounded apically; right mandible blade-like, narrowed towards the apex, pointed at the tip. Postmentum long, clavate, widest in the anterior quarter, waist long and narrow, narrowest midway between the widest point and the posterior margin (length 1.5–1.65, maximum width 0.48–0.53, waist width 0.25–0.28). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.30–0.35, width 0.85–0.90), anterior margin weakly concave, posterior margin straight.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow, antennae, labrum, postclypeus, thorax and legs yellowish white, abdomen semitransparent with the gut contents showing through; head and pronotum moderately setose, abdomen densely setose; total length 4.0–4.6. Head capsule subcircular, widest near the antennae (length to mandibular base 0.80–0.95, width 0.95–1.0). Frontal plate small and round (diameter 0.10), visible in strong light. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly shorter than segment 2, segment 4 shortest. Postclypeus weakly arched, almost half as long as wide, posterior margin convex, concave at midlength. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.23–0.30, width 0.53–0.56).
